package.description: A GUI for controlling piezoelectric resonant motor devices

en-US.description: A GUI for controlling piezoelectric resonant motor devices
en-US.longDescription: The Elliptec System Software features an easy-to-use, GUI interface for compatible Windows® PCs which can be used to control the piezoelectric resonant motor devices. Custom applications can be created in any language. The source code is provided in C# format as part of the download.
en-US.name: Thorlabs ELLO
